caption:
Can your knee touch the wall? 🦶 Try this 30-second ankle test.

Half-kneel facing a wall, front toes about 4 inches (10 cm) away. Drive the knee forward to touch the wall.
✅ Pass: knee touches and the heel stays flat
❌ Not yet: the heel pops up or the knee can't reach
Test both sides.

Stiff ankles can make it harder to stay in posture and shift your weight through the swing.

Which side is tighter: L or R? Comment below 👇 Tomorrow we'll post 3 fixes.

Any pain during the test? Stop and get it checked.
